title: psycopg 3 'with connection' block closes the connection that psycopg2 kept open
symptoms: A module-level connection fails on its second use after a with block
cause: In psycopg2 the with block on a connection only ended the transaction. In psycopg 3 leaving the block closes the connection.
fix: Use conn.transaction() for transaction scope and keep long-lived connections outside a with block, or use psycopg_pool.
apply:
conn = psycopg.connect(DSN)
with conn.transaction():
    conn.execute("INSERT INTO t VALUES (1)")
# conn is still open here
affected: psycopg 3.x, when porting code from psycopg2
